intro: Build the claim. Choose the right piece for each blank. This is Day 4's own starter, the one in your 30-Second Case box.
sentence_frame: New machines and new power changed how goods were made by ___, so ___.
_starter_printed: New machines and new power changed how goods were made by ___.

tiles.text: bringing workers, machines and steam power together in one building
digging canals to carry coal from the mines to the towns
making a real difference to the way that things were produced
cloth was no longer made by hand at home the way it had been under the domestic system
machines are always faster than people working on their own
Britain was the first country in the world to industrialize

correct_sentence: New machines and new power changed how goods were made by bringing workers, machines and steam power together in one building, so cloth was no longer made by hand at home the way it had been under the domestic system.
hints: The first blank is the change itself. The second is what the change did to how people worked.
One wrong tile belongs to Day 5, and one of them says nothing at all.
rationale: A claim names the change and what the change did. 'Making a real difference' names no change, and 'machines are faster than people' would be true in any century. The factory is the answer: power, machines and workers in one place, instead of a family spinning at home.
